[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building has free observation decks on the 45th and 46th floors offering stunning views of the city.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The observation decks are open from 9:30 AM to 5:30 PM, with last entry at 5:00 PM.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To get to the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building from Shinjuku, the user can walk 10 minutes or take the Toei Oedo subway line.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The user can expect crowds at the observation decks, especially on weekends and holidays.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The user should be prepared for security checks before entering the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building.
